summary: Added sdk/state/client_provider.py with ClientSnapshotProvider(client, alias). Each call invokes getShipByUserId, listAllCharactersOfUser and listItemsOfAShip, extracts the Ship, Room, Research, Character and Item records, and calls build_snapshot. A read that raises, returns False or gives no payload leaves its sections missing and is listed in failed_reads. Minerals and gas are taken only from a single item typed Mineral or Gas, with no positional fallback. Starbux and trophies held from login are deliberately not reported. Exported from sdk.state. Added 8 fake-client tests, including one whose fake client fails on any method the capability inventory does not mark read-only. Documented in docs/baseline/account-snapshot.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Snapshots could only be built from dictionaries the caller assembled
contract_status_changes.after: A provider builds fresh snapshots from read-only Client calls, with explicit missing sections and no mutating calls

residual_risks: Payload shapes come from existing client code and mocked tests, not a current live capture.
Starbux and trophies are unknown in provider snapshots, so daily-reward reconciliation depends on resources and inventory only.
A secret-shaped copied value raises SnapshotInputError rather than leaving a section missing; this fails closed by design.
